page_summary: This page presents a table outlining common elements of regulation governing critical infrastructure, categorized into themes such as governance and accountability, risk prevention and protection, reporting and information-sharing, and resilience and continuity. Each theme includes a description and illustrative examples from various jurisdictions, including Australia, the EU, Hong Kong, Japan, and Singapore, highlighting specific legislative requirements and frameworks.
